searchText: what is a verkle trie? oh polynomial commitments <dankrad> <@387536747476549632> https://notes.ethereum.org/_N1mutVERDKtqGIEYc-Flw And trustless! zkSync for example is still a semi-trusted solution (upgradable with timelocks) which sadly makes it not much better than plasma as you have to pay attention (or trust) to not be robbed. <GuthL> This path to trustless is what Vitalik called Derisked. > On the paragraph about "when to expire" I was thinking about an analogy/concept from classic stock management: if it was desireable to sort of "smoothen" the transition from `value of full state` to `value with less/inactive state` one could apply the method of 'movement frequency'. e.g. there's a check every 30d /12m whether an article/address was moved and if not is devalued to a certain extent until it contains no book value anymore and is removed from the balance sheet. so in essence you'd have a gradually reduced definition between active or expired.

excerpts.content: > On the paragraph about "when to expire" I was thinking about an analogy/concept from classic stock management: if it was desireable to sort of "smoothen" the transition from `value of full state` to `value with less/inactive state` one could apply the method of 'movement frequency'. e.g. there's a check every 30d /12m whether an article/address was moved and if not is devalued to a certain extent until it contains no book value anymore and is removed from the balance sheet. so in essence you'd have a gradually reduced definition between active or expired.
